measures.item: own:perfboard USB access and wall mounting
measures.what: Two quick checks to finish: (1) Does the USB connector face one of the 50-mm-wide ends of the 50 x 70 perfboard? Can you orient that end downward, with nothing blocking a plug approaching from below? (2) Are suitable wall screws already installed, or will wall screws/anchors be supplied separately? If the finer dimensions are unavailable I can use an oversized bottom service opening and require a paper fit check before printing.
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge

limitations.wanted: A fully verified wall attachment and closely fitted USB opening, with an exact ESP32 assembly pose and matte-white print material.
limitations.blocked_by: Wall substrate/fixings, exact USB pose, disk thickness, and component/wire envelopes were not supplied despite measurement requests. Available filament is black PLA, and no wall anchors are in the permitted hardware.
limitations.why: Wall screw pull-out safety and USB plug access cannot be guaranteed from board dimensions alone. The design will use a generous service opening, explicitly provisional component poses, a fit coupon, and mandatory dry-fit checks; wall mounting must wait for a verified compatible wall attachment.
